title: Gloria Finance overview
summary: Gloria Finance is a church financial management system for registrations, treasury operations, configuration, banking, patrimony and reports.
capabilities: Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
Review and process member or online contributions
Configure financial concepts, availability accounts and cost centers
Configure suppliers, banks, financial months and church profile settings
Import bank statements and reconcile movements
Generate financial reports such as DRE, income statement and monthly tithes
Manage purchases, patrimony and devotional workflows
limitations: Some actions require concepts, accounts or centers to exist before registration
Analytical guidance depends on the report data or attached document provided by the user
